text:
Type: tall white and oak five-drawer chest
Use: storing clothes and small items; bedroom, hallway, small spaces
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, modern
Materials: oak-effect laminated frame in a white-stained finish, white matte drawer fronts
Colors: white, pale greyish oak
Shape: narrow upright cabinet with a wood-tone frame around five flush white drawers, small curved notch grips cut into the top edges, plinth base, clean lines, slim footprint
Feel: light, fresh, tidy, simple
Goes with: white walls, light wood floors, pale grey textiles; Scandinavian or minimalist bedrooms
